messages:
alex: Morning — deploy pipeline `deploy:model-fleet` just applied a sealedsecret in eu-west but the SOPS/KMS context in the sealed secret was for us-west. Result: registry creds didn't decrypt, GPU autoscaler couldn't pull images and new nodes stayed Pending. Anyone seen this before?
ops-ci: [CI] Job deploy:model-fleet #483 failed: sealed-secrets decrypt error -> `failed to decrypt: invalid key context` :x:
jordan: looking at the manifest — the sealedsecret has label `sops.k8s.aws/kms: arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redeem-usw2` but this is the eu-west-1 cluster. decrypt will always fail.
mira: yup — cluster logs show `image pull access denied` for gpu-node bootstrapping because the registry secret was not present. Several GPU jobs queued. Can we hotfix?
jordan: root cause is the chart defaulted the KMS alias. Overlay should override, but this secret came from a shared chart release pipeline that used the default value. PR #890 introduced the default to avoid CI noise.
katie: that was my change — I added a fallback default to avoid broken deploys on new clusters. I didn't intend for the CI to generate sealedsecrets with a global alias. My bad.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2027-027 - GPU provisioning delay due to sealed-secret decrypt/context mismatch. @oncall assigned: mira
mira: short-term playbook: re-encrypt the sealedsecret with the eu-west alias and reapply the sealedsecret object. I can do a quick regen+apply if alex signs off.
alex: please proceed. Also we need a pipeline check so this doesn't silently ship again — validate `sops.k8s.aws/kms` matches `cluster.region`.
ops-ci: quick workaround script: `./scripts/regen-sealedsecret.sh registry-creds eu-west-1` returns success. Running apply now.
mira: applying now:
```
kubectl apply -f sealedsecret-registry-creds-eu.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gpu-autoscaler -n infra
```
mira: decrypted secret present. kubelet logs show image pull succeeded. Autoscaler requested 3 new GPU nodes (p3.xlarge) and they are provisioning. Monitoring CPU/gpu metrics.
jordan: FYI terraform references `module.gpu_pool.secrets.registry_arn` during node bootstrap; if the secret is missing the autoscaler tries to proceed and fails later. We should add a preflight validation step in the infra CI so `terraform plan` fails early on missing secrets.
katie: I'll open a PR to remove the global default KMS alias and require per-cluster `sops_kms_alias`. Also adding a lint job in the deploy pipeline to compare alias region -> cluster region. README update too.
alex: good. Postmortem + followups in #postmortems. Action items: katie -> PR to remove default and add lint; ops-ci -> add sops alias check job; mira -> scan other clusters for mismatched sealedsecrets.
sre-bot: Incident resolved. Duration: 00:17:38. :white_check_mark:
